Claude AI Automation – How Does It Work?

Traditional automation follows predefined rules and conditions. But AI powered automation can interpret instructions, analyze information, and help make decisions based on the available context.

In this tutorial, we'll explore how Claude AI can work with automation tools to perform repetitive tasks, interact with applications, and simplify everyday workflows.

You'll understand how AI Agents, Claude AI, and automation frameworks can work together to create more flexible automation systems.

Browser Automation Using Claude AI

Imagine asking AI to open a website, navigate through pages, enter information, extract data, or perform a series of browser actions.

With the right tools and permissions, Claude AI can help automate supported browser workflows.

We'll explore how browser automation works and how you can use it for research, data collection, web applications, and repetitive online tasks.

Automate Your Laptop with AI

Browser automation is only one part of the process.

Using computer automation frameworks and AI-powered tools, you can also automate supported desktop workflows, interact with applications, manage files, and execute repetitive computer tasks.

Learn how Claude AI, computer-use tools, and automation frameworks can help you build practical automations without manually repeating every action.

LinkedIn Automation – AI Content Creation & Posting

What if you could prepare LinkedIn content automatically every day?

In this video, we'll explore an example of using AI to generate humanized LinkedIn posts based on your instructions, preferred writing style, and content requirements.

We'll also discuss how scheduled workflows can support LinkedIn content creation and publishing, subject to platform permissions and available integrations.

This workflow can be useful for personal branding, business marketing, social media management, and content creators who regularly publish professional content.

AI Agents vs Traditional Automation

Traditional automation works well when tasks follow predictable rules. But what happens when a workflow requires understanding context, analyzing information, or selecting the next action?

That's where AI-powered automation becomes useful.

We'll explore how AI Agents and Claude AI can support more flexible workflows and why human verification, reliable tools, and proper error handling remain important.

Build Your Own AI Automation Workflow

The goal of this tutorial is to help you understand how to move from manual tasks to AI-assisted workflows.

You'll learn how to identify repetitive tasks, provide clear instructions, select suitable automation tools, test your workflow, and improve its reliability.

Whether you want to automate browser activities, computer tasks, or business processes, these concepts will help you get started with practical AI automation.

videos.title: Harvard Psychiatrist: 90% of Criticism is Just Projection | Dr. K
videos.description:
You did everything right.
You took every step you were told to take.
Then one day you wake up and this isn't the life you want.
Dr. K says it's called a quarter life crisis, and almost no one can see it.

In this episode, Dr. K and Jay Shetty talk about why people in their 20s and 30s feel lost. The old plan for life no longer works, school costs too much, rent is too high and the goals we were given are out of reach.

Dr. K explains what to do when you feel late. He shares the Buddha's idea of the second arrow, and why it applies to good news too. And he tells the story of a patient who wouldn't quit smoking, until he asked him one hard question about his daughters.

Learn about the baggage you bring to every date without knowing it and why Dr. K says "be yourself" is the worst advice you can get.
